newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Firestone NZ makes 2 for 5 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Firestone NZ makes 2 for 5 bonus issue.

text.p: Firestone New Zealand Ltd on Tuesday announced a bonus issue of two new shares for each existing five shares held at NZ$3.35 per share.

Firestone NZ, 83 percent owned by Bridgestone/Firestone Inc, said the new shares will not participate in the previously announced final dividend for the 1996 year which is to be paid on April 24, the record date for the bonus issue.
This means the total number of Firestone shares on issue following the bonus will be 14.2 million.

The 4.0 million new shares will have full imputation credits of $1.64999 attached. The imputation credits on the bonus issue will virtually eliminate the imputation credit balance Firestone NZ has accumulated over the last five years.
The directors of Firestone NZ said the bonus issue reflects a willingness by the company to provide shareholders with additional value without compromising its operational needs.
